oracleBasis: Ordinary C# with the detached IDataSession semantics stated in inputs.json; expectations authored before generated execution.

cases.asserts: Two projection members assigned the same lambda parameter refer to one mutable object.
Another Select retains the aliased object while allocating a new outer projection.
Two new expressions with identical type, key and fields produce distinct objects.
Separately evaluated Query calls returning the same persisted key produce independent objects.
Local aliases observe mutation; a later detached read observes unchanged storage.
Update saves current fields exactly once; subsequent alias mutations remain local.
Insert returns the generated identity while every alias of the input retains Id zero and later local edits are not saved.
Two join results reuse the left occurrence; independent same-key right occurrence and result wrappers stay distinct.
A two-by-two join shares left and right occurrences across result rows without merging independent source sides.
A new object created before a fanout join is reused across its matching results, including its nested entity reference.
An object constructed after the join is new for every combined occurrence, while its source entity remains shared.
ToArray yields a reference array with aliased members within each projection and independent source rows.
FirstOrDefault and SingleOrDefault return null references for no results.
